channel.title: Living the Dream: Gospel Music Tribute to Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.
channel.desc: A tribute to Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., featuring historic gospel music performances by Aretha Franklin, The Williams Brothers, Lady Tramaine Hawkins, Andrae Crouch, Lou Rawls, The Barrett Sisters, Wintley Phipps and more; Pastor Mike Jr. hosts.
